--- title: "(θ, φ) validation — locked Stage-1 winner + double-sin profile" subtitle: "Does the locked configuration generalise across the full angular matrix for SS\\_12-3?" author: "Bolu / Josu" date: 2026-05-09 format: html: code-fold: false toc: true toc-depth: 2 embed-resources: true fig-width: 12 fig-height: 5 jupyter: rcwa-venv execute: cache: false echo: true warning: false --- > **Decoupled report.** Reads the outputs of [bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py](../bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py) > from [runs/validate_thetaphi/](../runs/validate_thetaphi/). 15 configurations > at the same locked parameters (NA = 39, t_oxide = 0.9 µm, β = 2°, > oxide = HS_caliente, A₂ = 0.30 µm, φ₂ = π/2), varying only (θ, φ_exp). > > If χ²_red is roughly homogeneous across the (θ, φ) cells, the locked > universal Tier-1 result generalises. If one cell dominates the χ², we > have a structural angular issue. # 1. Load results ::: {#cell-load .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import sys from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import pandas as pd import matplotlib.pyplot as plt sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib"))) import sweep_runner as sr import plot_helpers plot_helpers._ensure_latex_rcparams() OUT = Path("./sweep/runs/validate_thetaphi") results_csv = OUT / "results.csv" decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt" traces_dir = OUT / "traces" assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python sweep/bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py` first." df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values(["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg"]).reset_index(drop=True) print(f"{len(df)} cells loaded") df[["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "phi_sim_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]].round(3) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 15 cells loaded ``` ::: ::: {#load .cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=9} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: # 2. χ²_red over the (θ, φ) grid ::: {#cell-heatmap .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.5), constrained_layout=True) # χ² heatmap (linear scale — they may all be O(100), so linear is more legible than log) piv = df.pivot(index="theta_exp_deg", columns="phi_exp_deg", values="Rdet_chi2_red") im = ax[0].imshow(piv.values, aspect="auto", origin="lower", cmap="viridis_r") ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(piv.columns))); ax[0].set_xticklabels([f"{p:g}°" for p in piv.columns]) ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(piv.index))); ax[0].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}°" for t in piv.index]) ax[0].set_xlabel(r"$\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}$"); ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$\theta$") ax[0].set_title(r"$\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}(R_{\mathrm{det}})$ across $(\theta, \varphi_{\mathrm{exp}})$") plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax[0], label=r"$\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}$") # annotate cells for i, t in enumerate(piv.index): for j, p in enumerate(piv.columns): v = piv.values[i, j] ax[0].text(j, i, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="center", color="white" if v > piv.values.mean() else "black", fontsize=9) # Pearson r heatmap piv_r = df.pivot(index="theta_exp_deg", columns="phi_exp_deg", values="Rdet_pearson_r") im2 = ax[1].imshow(piv_r.values, aspect="auto", origin="lower", cmap="viridis", vmin=0.5, vmax=1.0) ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(piv_r.columns))); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{p:g}°" for p in piv_r.columns]) ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(piv_r.index))); ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}°" for t in piv_r.index]) ax[1].set_xlabel(r"$\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}$"); ax[1].set_ylabel(r"$\theta$") ax[1].set_title("Pearson r") plt.colorbar(im2, ax=ax[1], label="r") for i, t in enumerate(piv_r.index): for j, p in enumerate(piv_r.columns): v = piv_r.values[i, j] ax[1].text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", color="white" if v < 0.85 else "black", fontsize=9) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](validate_thetaphi_report_files/figure-html/heatmap-output-1.png){#heatmap width=1162 height=443} ::: ::: # 3. Aggregate statistics ::: {#stats .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} print(f"χ²_red — sum : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].sum():8.2f}") print(f" — mean : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].mean():8.2f}") print(f" — median : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].median():8.2f}") print(f" — min : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].min():8.2f} (best cell)") print(f" — max : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].max():8.2f} (worst cell)") print(f" — max/min: {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].max() / df['Rdet_chi2_red'].min():.2f}") print() print("Best 3 cells:") print(df.nsmallest(3, "Rdet_chi2_red")[ ["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"] ].round(3).to_string(index=False)) print() print("Worst 3 cells:") print(df.nlargest(3, "Rdet_chi2_red")[ ["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"] ].round(3).to_string(index=False)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` χ²_red — sum : 5132.39 — mean : 342.16 — median : 142.01 — min : 75.49 (best cell) — max : 1157.65 (worst cell) — max/min: 15.33 Best 3 cells: theta_exp_deg phi_exp_deg Rdet_chi2_red Rdet_RMSE Rdet_pearson_r 30.0 45.0 75.491 0.089 0.965 30.0 22.5 82.960 0.093 0.965 30.0 90.0 86.658 0.093 0.947 Worst 3 cells: theta_exp_deg phi_exp_deg Rdet_chi2_red Rdet_RMSE Rdet_pearson_r 60.0 0.0 1157.651 0.340 0.942 60.0 22.5 1070.994 0.327 0.893 60.0 90.0 603.283 0.246 0.857 ``` ::: ::: # 4. Best cell — full comparison plot ::: {#cell-best-cell .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} best = df.loc[df["Rdet_chi2_red"].idxmin()] phi_sim_best = sr.SimConfig( period_um=12.9, A_um=1.5, t_oxide_um=0.9, oxide_dispersion="HS_caliente", theta_deg=float(best["theta_exp_deg"]), phi_sim_deg=float(best["phi_sim_deg"]), harmonics=39, slices=50, beta_deg=2.0, A2_um=0.30, phi2_rad=float(np.pi/2), wavelengths_um=np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25), ).filename_stem() best_avg_path = traces_dir / phi_sim_best / f"AVG_{phi_sim_best}.csv" EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental") phi_str_map = {0: "0", 22.5: "22-5", 45: "45", 67.5: "67-5", 90: "90"} phi_str = phi_str_map[float(best["phi_exp_deg"])] exp_paths = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob(f"12-3_{int(best['theta_exp_deg'])}_{phi_str}_*.CSV")) fig, ax = plot_helpers.plot_comparison_with_residual( sim_avg_path = best_avg_path, exp_paths = exp_paths, observable = "R_det", sample_label = "12-3", theta_exp_deg = float(best["theta_exp_deg"]), phi_exp_deg = float(best["phi_exp_deg"]), beta_deg = 2.0, figsize = (8, 7), title = (rf"Best cell: $\theta={best['theta_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, " rf"$\varphi_{{\mathrm{{exp}}}}={best['phi_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, " rf"$\chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}={best['Rdet_chi2_red']:.1f}$"), ) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](validate_thetaphi_report_files/figure-html/best-cell-output-1.png){#best-cell width=779 height=683} ::: ::: # 5. Worst cell — full comparison plot ::: {#cell-worst-cell .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} worst = df.loc[df["Rdet_chi2_red"].idxmax()] phi_sim_worst = sr.SimConfig( period_um=12.9, A_um=1.5, t_oxide_um=0.9, oxide_dispersion="HS_caliente", theta_deg=float(worst["theta_exp_deg"]), phi_sim_deg=float(worst["phi_sim_deg"]), harmonics=39, slices=50, beta_deg=2.0, A2_um=0.30, phi2_rad=float(np.pi/2), wavelengths_um=np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25), ).filename_stem() worst_avg_path = traces_dir / phi_sim_worst / f"AVG_{phi_sim_worst}.csv" phi_str = phi_str_map[float(worst["phi_exp_deg"])] exp_paths_w = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob(f"12-3_{int(worst['theta_exp_deg'])}_{phi_str}_*.CSV")) fig, ax = plot_helpers.plot_comparison_with_residual( sim_avg_path = worst_avg_path, exp_paths = exp_paths_w, observable = "R_det", sample_label = "12-3", theta_exp_deg = float(worst["theta_exp_deg"]), phi_exp_deg = float(worst["phi_exp_deg"]), beta_deg = 2.0, figsize = (8, 7), title = (rf"Worst cell: $\theta={worst['theta_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, " rf"$\varphi_{{\mathrm{{exp}}}}={worst['phi_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, " rf"$\chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}={worst['Rdet_chi2_red']:.1f}$"), ) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](validate_thetaphi_report_files/figure-html/worst-cell-output-1.png){#worst-cell width=779 height=683} ::: ::: # 6. Decision text ::: {#decision .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} if decision_txt.exists(): print(decision_txt.read_text()) else: print("decision.txt not found.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # Validate (θ, φ) — sum / mean / range over 15 configs chi2_red sum = 5132.39 chi2_red mean = 342.16 chi2_red median = 142.01 chi2_red min = 75.49 chi2_red max = 1157.65 chi2_red ratio max/min = 15.33 Per-cell chi2_red(R_det): phi_exp_deg 0.0 22.5 45.0 67.5 90.0 theta_exp_deg 30.0 104.2 83.0 75.5 88.5 86.7 45.0 262.7 231.9 138.5 142.0 96.2 60.0 1157.7 1071.0 568.2 423.0 603.3 ``` ::: ::: # 7. Verdict ::: {#verdict .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} ratio = df["Rdet_chi2_red"].max() / df["Rdet_chi2_red"].min() print(f"χ²_red max/min ratio = {ratio:.2f}") if ratio < 2.0: print("\n✓ Roughly homogeneous across (θ, φ_exp). The locked configuration generalises.") print(" The remaining ~100 χ²_red is the same structural residual seen at (30°, 0°),") print(" pointing to the Cr2O3 phonon model. Stage 2 / 3 can proceed without a fundamental") print(" angular structural fix.") elif ratio < 5.0: print("\n◌ Moderate angular variation. The locked configuration is approximately right") print(" but not perfectly uniform. Worth examining the worst cell's residual shape") print(" before committing to materials work.") else: print("\n✗ Strong angular dependence — one or more (θ, φ) cells fit dramatically worse.") print(" This is structural. Possible diagnoses:") print(" - φ_sim mapping `90° − φ_exp` is wrong for non-zero φ_exp") print(" - Geometric model (sinusoidal grating) is missing 2D structure visible at") print(" certain incidence angles") print(" - The β = 2° detector aperture is angle-dependent in the physical setup") print(" Resolve before attempting Cr2O3 phonon work.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` χ²_red max/min ratio = 15.33 ✗ Strong angular dependence — one or more (θ, φ) cells fit dramatically worse. This is structural. Possible diagnoses: - φ_sim mapping `90° − φ_exp` is wrong for non-zero φ_exp - Geometric model (sinusoidal grating) is missing 2D structure visible at certain incidence angles - The β = 2° detector aperture is angle-dependent in the physical setup Resolve before attempting Cr2O3 phonon work. ``` ::: :::
